rationale: Widening EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES would make verify_work_was_done() reject legitimate closes for issues whose sole deliverable is a .ll/-scoped change (e.g. a decisions-log entry), since that gate short-circuits to False when filter_excluded_files() returns empty across all diff sources. The two questions (was real work done vs. is this dirty path noise for the completion commit) are unrelated and issue_lifecycle.py does not currently import the shared constant.
rule: Noise-filter .ll/ exclusion: use a new adjacent .ll/-only set scoped to issue_lifecycle.py's completion-commit noise filter, not the shared EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES constant
alternatives_rejected: Option A: add .ll/ to the shared EXCLUDED_DIRECTORIES constant (rejected: entangles verify_work_was_done()'s unrelated gate, risking false blocks on legitimate .ll/-only closes)
